title: Mediterranean Frittata
description: A flavorful and healthy Mediterranean-inspired frittata, perfect for a quick breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: mediterranean
ingredients.notes: Chopped Kalamata olives and artichoke hearts

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the chopped Kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, Mediterranean cheese, and crumbled feta to the bowl. Mix well.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch (23cm) pie plate or skillet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve warm.
